title: Causal exclusion: physical causes leave nothing for mental properties to do

statements.text: Even for physicalists who distinguish mental properties from the physical properties that realize them, Kim argues that the mental properties are excluded from any causal role. The physical properties of neural events and the brain's connectivity suffice to produce later neural events and so behavior, which leaves nothing for mental properties to do.

sources.quote: There is nothing left for mental properties to do.
